name: disk_automation_20261104
comment: ANCHOR: DISK_AUTOMATION_20261104 — the three disk behaviours the operator named on 2026-11-04. Release cleanup on promote is REPORT-ONLY (2026-11-04, finding wins): the scheduled lane names a superseded release and its bytes and never removes it, because a retained descriptor survives every pathname fence and same-uid quiescence cannot be enforced. Removal needs a ReleaseArming object naming one path, parsed from an operator-authored file — not a config key, so it cannot be expressed as a scheduled deletion — and remove_item refuses a release without one, from the standing apply, the legacy plan and every caller alike. The holder scan counts holders (cwd AND descriptors) independently of whether a unit can be restarted. Agent scratch keeps a 24 h floor (operator D16) and a 10 GB ceiling, oldest-first on fingerprint.activity, and cannot evict a row it cannot date (missing, NaN or infinite age). The jsonl-archive-rotate promotion is recorded, not armed. Hermetic: fake /proc, pure row fixtures, committed config files; no real deletion, no systemctl call, no network.
